questions.q: Someone set `AHRS_EKF_TYPE = 0` on ArduCopter 4.7.2. What happens?
options: The copter flies on DCM, and position-controlled modes become unavailable
The pre-arm check refuses to arm: "AHRS: not using configured AHRS type"
The parameter is ignored, and the copter flies on EKF3 as usual with no message
The board reports the config error "EKF1 not available"
questions.explain: Copter, Heli and Sub have FLAG_ALWAYS_USE_EKF: the firmware turns the value 0 into an EKF, but the pre-arm check compares the stored parameter with the actual backend and refuses. "EKF1 not available" is the reaction to the value 1.

questions.q: Is EKF2 present in the standard ArduPilot 4.7.2 firmware for a Pixhawk-compatible board?
options: Yes, but it is off by default: setting `EK2_ENABLE = 1` is all it takes
No: it is not compiled in, and `AHRS_EKF_TYPE = 2` quietly becomes 3
Yes, and it always runs in parallel with EKF3 as a hot standby
Only on H7; it was cut from F4 and F7 for lack of flash space
questions.explain: Since 4.5 HAL_NAVEKF2_AVAILABLE = 0 by default; in 4.7.2 only SITL and the EKF2 option of the custom build server enable it. AP_AHRS::init() replaces 2 with 3 when EKF2 is absent. The EK2_* parameters in the documentation are no sign that the filter exists.

questions.q: SITL Copter, Loiter, GPS switched off. Why did the EKF failsafe trigger although the variances are small?
questions.fragment:
69.8 s  SET  SIM_GPS1_ENABLE = 0
76.1 s  EKF  vel=0.01 pos=0.01 hgt=0.00 mag=0.01 flags=0x033f
77.8 s  MSG  EKF3 lane switch 1
78.1 s  MODE LAND
78.1 s  MSG  EKF variance
78.1 s  MSG  EKF Failsafe: changed to Land Mode
78.1 s  EKF  vel=0.01 pos=0.01 hgt=0.00 mag=0.01 flags=0x0025
options: FS_EKF_THRESH is set to 0.01, and even small variances exceed it
The horizontal position bits are gone, and ekf_check counts that as a failure
An EKF3 lane switch by itself always puts the copter into LAND mode
The variances reach the GCS 8 s late, and in reality they were above 1
questions.explain: Copter::ekf_check() requires both variances below the threshold and a position. The flags 0x033f → 0x0025 lost 2, 8, 16, 256 and 512 (horizontal velocity, relative and absolute position and their predictions), while the variances stayed at 0.01. The lane switch is the check_lane_switch attempt before the failsafe.

questions.q: ArduPlane 4.7.2 with an airspeed sensor is flying in LOITER, and GPS is lost completely. What does the AHRS do?
options: It switches to DCM at once and holds the last heading until GPS returns
It stays on EKF3 and dead-reckons on airspeed and the wind estimate
It triggers the EKF failsafe and puts the plane into QLAND mode
It switches the active source set to EK3_SRC2 by itself
questions.explain: On a complete loss of fix EKF3 keeps horizontal velocity and relative position (flags 0x012f, bit 18 in XKF4.SS is dead reckoning), so the conditions for the DCM fallback are not met. The Plane EKF failsafe acts only in position-controlled VTOL modes; source sets do not switch by themselves.

questions.q: What do multiple EKF3 cores (lanes) protect against?
options: The failure or noise of one IMU
Loss of GPS signal on all receivers
Compass interference from power wires
Barometer error in the prop wash
questions.explain: A core is created for each IMU in EK3_IMU_MASK; all cores see the same GPS, compass and baro, so a lane switch does not cure a common sensor failure. In SITL it was useless on a GPS loss.

questions.q: In `XKF4` core 0 has `SV = 0.44`, and `EK3_VEL_I_GATE = 500`. What velocity innovation in sigmas does that correspond to?
questions.explain: SV = |y| / ((G/100)·√S), so |y|/√S = SV · G/100 = 0.44 · 5 = 2.2σ. 0.19 is the square, that is the test ratio itself; 4σ is the FS_EKF_THRESH 0.8 threshold with the same gate.

questions.q: A compass-less copter: `COMPASS_USE = 0` for all, `EK3_SRC1_YAW = 8`. You try to arm in Loiter. What do you see?
options: PreArm: EK3_MAG_CAL and EK3_SRC1_YAW inconsistent
Arming succeeds: GSF takes yaw from GPS while still on the ground
PreArm: Need Position Estimate
PreArm: AHRS: waiting for home
questions.explain: GSF derives yaw from motion: on the ground there is no yaw and no EKF3 position, and Loiter requires one. Arm in AltHold and fly straight for 5–10 s until "EKF3 IMU0 yaw aligned using GPS". The EK3_MAG_CAL line applies only to the deprecated values 5 and 6.

questions.q: A companion computer has to switch EKF3 to source set 2 (VIO) over MAVLink. How?
options: MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET with param1 = 2
MAV_CMD_SET_EKF_SOURCE_SET with param1 = 1
PARAM_SET with EK3_SRC_OPTIONS = 2
SET_GPS_GLOBAL_ORIGIN with the set number
questions.explain: The command accepts 1…3 and subtracts one before calling set_posvelyaw_source_set(0…2); out of range gives MAV_RESULT_DENIED. EK3_SRC_OPTIONS is a bitmask of options, not a set number.

questions.q: ArduCopter 4.7.2, standard firmware for an F405 with 1 MB of flash. Can you feed the pose from a VIO camera to EKF3?
options: Yes: VISO_TYPE = 1 and EK3_SRC1_POSXY = 6, exactly as on any H7 board
No: ExternalNav, VisualOdom and MAVLink GPS are not compiled in at 1 MB
Yes, but through EKF2: set EK2_ENABLE, external navigation is simpler there
Yes: AHRS_EKF_TYPE = 11 (ExternalAHRS) accepts the pose from a VIO camera
questions.explain: EK3_FEATURE_EXTERNAL_NAV and HAL_VISUALODOM_ENABLED require HAL_PROGRAM_SIZE_LIMIT_KB > 1024, and minimize_common.inc also disables MAVLink GPS (GPS_INPUT) on 1 MB boards. EKF2 is not compiled in on 4.7, and ExternalAHRS is for ready-made INS units, not for VIO. The way out is a larger board or a custom build server build, if it fits.

questions.q: In flight with the compass enabled you got "EKF3 IMU0 emergency yaw reset". What happened?
questions.fragment:
EK3_SRC1_YAW = 1
EK3_GSF_RUN_MASK = 3
EK3_GSF_USE_MASK = 3
EK3_GSF_RST_MAX = 2
MSG: EKF3 IMU0 emergency yaw reset
options: EKF3 restarted all cores from scratch and realigned the tilt
Yaw was reset from the GSF estimator, and the compass was marked failed
The compass was recalibrated in flight by the COMPASS_LEARN algorithm
Yaw was switched to the second GPS antenna (moving baseline)
questions.explain: The autopilot requests a yaw reset two iterations before the EKF failsafe; EKFGSF_resetMainFilterYaw sets the GSF yaw, resets velocity and position to GPS and marks all compasses as failed. With EK3_GSF_RST_MAX = 2 there are no more than two such resets per flight.
